Recommended order

  1. Zoe & Grizzbolt (Lv 10) — Windswept Island
  2. Lily & Lyleen (Lv 20) — Crescent Moon Shore
  3. Axel & Orserk (Lv 30) — Mount Obsidian
  4. Marcus & Faleris (Lv 40) — Desiccated Dunes
  5. Victor & Shadowbeak (Lv 50) — Astral Mountains
  6. Saya & Selyne (Lv 55) — Sakurajima Island
  7. Bjorn & Bastigor (Lv 60) — Feybreak Island
  8. Auri & Shaolong (Lv 68) — Sunreach

Hard mode

After clearing all towers, hard mode unlocks for each tower. Most hard modes are level 55, with the final two (Bjorn & Bastigor, Auri & Shaolong) being 60 and 80. Hard mode rewards include Access Keys, which unlock special dungeons with rare loot. Bring a strong, type-matched team and plenty of healing items — hard mode bosses hit significantly harder than their normal versions.

Tip: use the Work Suitability Finder and Breeding Calculator to build a strong team before challenging the higher towers.

Frequently asked questions

How many towers are in Palworld?

There are 8 faction towers in Palworld: Rayne Syndicate, Free Pal Alliance, Brothers of the Eternal Pyre, PIDF, PAL Genetic Research Unit, Moonflower, Feybreak, and Azure Covenant.

What is the recommended tower order in Palworld?

Follow boss level: Zoe and Grizzbolt (Lv 10) first, then Lily and Lyleen (Lv 20), Axel and Orserk (Lv 30), Marcus and Faleris (Lv 40), Victor and Shadowbeak (Lv 50), Saya and Selyne (Lv 55), Bjorn and Bastigor (Lv 60), and finally Auri and Shaolong (Lv 68).

What is the highest level tower boss in Palworld?

Azure Covenant Tower is the highest at level 68, with hard mode at level 80.

Do tower bosses respawn?

Tower bosses can be re-challenged. Clearing a tower unlocks its hard mode, which you can attempt again for better rewards.
